description: This source file defines a Spring MVC controller named StoreBrandingController, responsible for managing store branding functionalities such as displaying branding options, saving branding changes (including logo uploads and template selection), and removing store logos within the admin interface of an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: StoreBrandingController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling store branding functionalities such as logo upload, template selection, and logo removal.

methods.name: displayStoreBranding
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the store branding page, setting up necessary model attributes such as the store itself and available templates.

methods.name: saveStoreBranding
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save store branding, including uploading a new store logo and updating the store entity.

methods.name: saveTemplate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the store template selection.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Handles POST requests to remove the store's logo image, returning a JSON response indicating success or failure.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set up menu-related model attributes for the UI.
